lesson.subtitle: Lesson 28 -- In My Opinion
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Rodrigo Luiz | Lesson 28 -- In My Opinion
lesson.grammar_point: opinion starters and response markers (I think / in my view / I agree / I don't agree / really?)

listenings.text: Hi Rodrigo, it's Claire. Thank you for your comments on the forum. Really interesting! I agree with you about speed: local teams are faster. But I'm not sure about the price. In my view, we can buy the big ingredients in Paris and the small ones in Brazil. What do you think? Let's talk on Thursday.

Hi Rodrigo, Tom here. You asked my opinion about New York restaurants. In my opinion, the best pizza is in Brooklyn, not in Manhattan. Some people disagree, of course! And I think you should try a steakhouse. The steaks are expensive, but they are amazing. Really, you won't be sorry.

extra_audio.text: The group wants to centralize purchasing in Paris. Pierre said: in my view, the benefit is the price. Ana disagreed: the downside is speed. Claire asked Rodrigo: what do you think? Rodrigo gave his opinion, and the group listened.

reading.rtitle: Global Forum -- Should Purchasing Be Centralized in Paris?
paras: Next year, the group wants to change how it buys raw material. Before the forum, two directors posted their opinions.

Pierre, Purchasing Director, Paris: "In my view, we should centralize purchasing in Paris. The big benefit is the price: if we buy for every plant together, the suppliers will give us better prices. I think it is the best option for the group."

Ana, Operations Manager, Mexico: "I disagree. A central team is far from the plants. The downside is speed: if there is a problem, a local team solves it faster. In my opinion, every plant should keep its local suppliers."
Next step: Every director will give an opinion at the forum next month. Rodrigo is going to speak for Brazil.
